decision_rule: Do not default to full evacuation if projected plume/dose timing is shorter than proven movement time; require shelter/evacuation sequencing decision log
minimum_local_evidence: dose assessment; PAR/PAD decision log; shelter message; staged evacuation plan; exposure control for emergency workers

decision_rule: Use 6h/9h45m public context as stress floor for traffic-control proof
minimum_local_evidence: current traffic-control roster; tow/fuel/bridge plan; route clearance; public instruction timing; reception open-status proof

decision_rule: Cap ETE-based claim until current official ETE/KLD packet is loaded
minimum_local_evidence: current ETE/KLD artifact, assumptions, hash, and exercise comparison

decision_rule: Require public-behavior evidence and traffic-model sensitivity before relying on 10-mile clearance estimates
minimum_local_evidence: survey/call-center/social-listening evidence; outer-ring traffic interaction; rumor-control plan

decision_rule: Do not use residential vehicle ETE as proof that no-car/AFN/school/LTC/hospital populations can move
minimum_local_evidence: transport registry; fleet contracts; driver roster; destination acceptance; medication/oxygen continuity

decision_rule: Convert public ETE into degraded-route inject when river crossings/flood/accident/contraflow constraints appear
minimum_local_evidence: route closure inject; alternate route assignment; mutual aid law enforcement; wrecker/fuel proof

decision_rule: Public capacity surplus does not prove reception readiness
minimum_local_evidence: facility agreements, staffing, supplies, power/water/sanitation, accessibility, security, exercise throughput

decision_rule: Public mass-care numbers do not prove monitoring/decon throughput
minimum_local_evidence: portal monitor staffing/calibration, queue model, decon waste path, medical split-flow

decision_rule: Future exercise notice cannot close any result row
minimum_local_evidence: official exercise result, AAR/IP, deficiencies, CAP owner/due date, retest and closure

decision_rule: EOF power-loss event remains open until local closure packet is loaded
minimum_local_evidence: restoration proof, generator RCA, compensatory measures, communications/assessment retest, EP04 reconciliation, CAP closure

decision_rule: PI/action matrix cannot by itself close local emergency-readiness proof
minimum_local_evidence: raw feed hash, unit reconciliation, public signal/counterevidence path, local evidence packet

decision_rule: No green/ready/safe/certified claim until route capacity, alerting, offsite packet, exercise results and EN58200 closure pass gates
minimum_local_evidence: claim gate record; redaction review; no-average-away proof
